name: microsoft/glTF-Toolkit
description: Collection of C++ tools and libraries for modifying and optimizing glTF assets, including texture packing, compression, mesh LOD merging, and a command-line converter for Windows Mixed Reality.
score_rationale: Narrowly scoped to Windows Mixed Reality with 316 stars and no commits since 2019, making it largely obsolete for general use.
summary: glTF optimization tools for packing, compression, and LOD merging
